action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
Marc Luchian and Liviu-Alexandru Bud discovered that nginx did not
correctly handle certain configurations using the try_files and alias
directives. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause nginx
to crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2026-125283)

Vivek Parikh discovered that nginx did not correctly handle parsing certain
ClientHello messages. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to
leak sensitive information. This issue was only addressed in
Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 24.04 LTS.
(CVE-2026-123640)

It was discovered that nginx did not correctly handle certain TLS
connections. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a
denial of service. This issue was only addressed in Ubuntu 18.04 LTS,
Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 22.04 LTS. (CVE-2026-118899)
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in nginx.
title: nginx vulnerabilities
